name: klayback
caption:
2.5 YEARS GONE 🎮🏀 Klay tore his ACL, then his Achilles. Could he ever come back?

• 2019 Finals, Game 6: tears his ACL with 30 points
• Then an Achilles tear in a pickup game: out for all of 2020-21
• Jan 9, 2022: back after 2.5 years, 17 points in 20 minutes vs Cleveland
• We win 96-82
• That June: ring number 4

Best comeback in our history? 👇

facts.claim: Klay Thompson's season debut on January 9 (9th), 2022 vs Cleveland

Thompson: in Game 6 of the 2019 Finals he tore his ACL and left with 30 points; November 2020: Achilles tendon injury suffered in a pickup game, missed the entire 2020-21 season; after missing over two and a half (2.5) years he returned in 2021-22 and won his fourth (4) title in 2022; 4x champion 2015-2022
